title: Build a same-signal trivial edit for the pronoun-swap tasks
description: A deterministic builder that changes the text by about the same number of tokens as the pronoun swap without changing any protected signal (for example a second neutral phrasing of a date or a place). Pre-register it, build for all seven Bias in Bios tasks, and record the cue in scoring TASK_CUES.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Merged to develop in PR #90. Rule: fifteen meaning-preserving swaps, at most three per bio; coverage 42-72% per task, about 0.9 tokens changed on average, so the floor flip rate is reported over the touched bios with the coverage beside it (docs/trivial-edit-floor-preregistration.md). Answers not yet collected.
